text:
Maya: Quick thread to finalize the "Slate 2" design-partner intake + prioritization scoreboard. Objective: 4 partners in 6 weeks, clear P0/P1 mapping.
Devon: We need compact incentives and a rubric that's cheap to operate. Draft: Partner tiering = Pilot (no $$, 4-week onboarding), Partner (credits $3k + 2 SRE hours), Champion ($15k + priority roadmap slot).
Aleks: Champion should require a short anonymized case study and a 6-week stability commit. Also add a one-time ops stipend for on-prem installs.
Sven: Feedback capture: use console tag dp/engage and require these fields in intake: reproducible (y/n), impact (low/med/high), user-visible (y/n), suggested-fix (short). dp-bot should create GH issue on submit.
dp-bot: Intake form deployed: https://internal.redwood/dp/slate2 (auto-tag dp/engage).
Maya: Scoring idea (simple): reproducible=3, impact high=2, user-visible=1. total>=5 -> P0, 3-4 -> P1, else backlog. Weight by tier: Champion x1.25, Partner x1.1, Pilot x1.0.
Devon: Onboarding cadence: Pilot 2 wks, Partner 3 wks, Champion 6 wks. Checklist: API keys, sample prompts, eval harness, e2e smoke. I'll draft templates.
Aleks: Success criteria to stay active: integration with >=5 valid calls/day by week 3 OR daily eval runs with stable metrics. If neither, offer downgrade and re-enroll later.
Sven: Infra gating: staging SLOs hold for 48h, median latency target depending on QPS. We'll estimate sizing after partner sign-up.
Maya: Action items: @Devon templates, @Aleks case-study & gating doc, @Sven security intake additions, @Maya publish partner FAQ. Reconvene Wed.
Devon: I'll post templates tomorrow.
Aleks: Gating doc draft by EOD.
Sven: Adding KMS checkbox and retention caps to intake.
Maya: Thanks all. Keep cohort small and measurable. :seedling:
